name: aggregate-index-edge-sums
tables: CREATE TABLE t (id BIGINT NOT NULL, g BIGINT, v BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY (id))
CREATE INDEX sum_by_g AS SELECT SUM(v) FROM t GROUP BY g

groups.name: having-sum-is-null-vs-derived
groups.reason: HAVING SUM(v) IS NULL keeps exactly the groups whose SUM is NULL (every v NULL); equals filtering the materialized group SUM for IS NULL — probes that an all-NULL group's sum is represented as NULL, not 0
queries: SELECT g FROM t GROUP BY g HAVING SUM(v) IS NULL
SELECT g FROM (SELECT g, SUM(v) AS s FROM t GROUP BY g) x WHERE s IS NULL

groups.name: having-sum-zero-vs-derived
groups.reason: HAVING SUM(v) = 0 keeps groups whose values cancel to zero; an all-NULL group's SUM is NULL and fails =0 under 3VL (excluded by both forms); equals the derived WHERE s = 0 on any data
queries: SELECT g FROM t GROUP BY g HAVING SUM(v) = 0
SELECT g FROM (SELECT g, SUM(v) AS s FROM t GROUP BY g) x WHERE s = 0

groups.name: having-sum-notnull-vs-derived
groups.reason: HAVING SUM(v) IS NOT NULL keeps groups with at least one non-NULL v; complements the IS NULL group and equals the derived WHERE s IS NOT NULL
queries: SELECT g, SUM(v) FROM t GROUP BY g HAVING SUM(v) IS NOT NULL
SELECT g, s FROM (SELECT g, SUM(v) AS s FROM t GROUP BY g) x WHERE s IS NOT NULL
